My Multimodal Math Mentor is a 5-agent LangGraph pipeline that answers handwritten, spoken and typed math queries; a Human-in-the-Loop checkpoint below 80% confidence gave 25% fewer hallucinations and 30% better answer relevance. At Walstar Technologies I redesigned a RAG chatbot with Mistral and LangChain, improving answer quality by 30%.

Agentic workflows on LLMs with Python and LangChain is exactly what I have been building.

I graduate from VIT Vellore in 2026 with a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering and can join immediately, remote, hybrid or onsite. GitHub: https://github.com/vedantp3 Portfolio: https://vedantpatil.vercel.app Resume attached.
